gen-gf-walter-turncoat-fs-hind: Relaxed copper-pipe letters in Walter Turncoat sit tall in the middle, with shallow ascenders and descenders. Hind is a plain sans with string-steady strokes, and it does best when the text stays brief.
gen-gf-walter-turncoat-fs-pilcrow-rounde: Warm, tightly spaced letters give Pilcrow Rounded its easy read, with big counters in a tall lowercase. While Walter Turncoat adds casual, bent-copper looseness, it is best spent on just a couple of lines.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Warnes draws its stretched, spacious letters with no stroke contrast at all, ink tapering away before it touches. BhuTuka Expanded One slows the eye to a leisurely walk, curvy and literary down the whole column.
gen-gf-yomogi-outfit: Hand-drawn charm: Yomogi gives every curve and straight a single width, with a crescent-wrench c opened wide and welcoming. Yomogi sets the mood, while sans-serif Outfit keeps brief copy clean.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-fs-amulya: Round, open, hand-drawn letters: Yuji Hentaigana Akari leaves big side gaps and stays clear at small sizes. Amulya, a modern sans-serif with generous curve gaps, keeps running text moving smoothly.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-fs-neco: Neco is a serif with a measured swell from hairline to stem, its letters never seeming to pinch shut. Give Yuji Hentaigana Akari the larger size and just a few lines.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-plus-jakart: Plus Jakarta Sans is monoline and precise, its curve endings kept well apart in a modern, constant-width build. Yuji Hentaigana Akari adds relaxed, hand-drawn warmth, so reading stays smooth.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-space-grote: Yuji Hentaigana Akari draws open round letters with big side gaps, relaxed and personal. Space Grotesk, a sans-serif with breathing counters, makes modest stretches of text pleasant going.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akebono-fs-amulya: Yuji Hentaigana Akebono writes friendly, casual letters with considerable room between them, apertures staying open at tiny sizes. Amulya, a modern sans, leaves generous gaps in every curve, so text flows.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akebono-fs-plein: Friendly, casual letters from Yuji Hentaigana Akebono keep considerable room between neighbors and apertures open at tiny sizes. Plein adds a clear channel leading into each round letter, so brief reading sessions stay reliable.
